Check that this phone and the PC are on the same Wi-Fi, and that you allowed SysWatch when Windows Firewall asked.
Check that Tailscale is switched on, on this phone and on the PC, and signed in to the same account on both.
That code does not look right
It is 6 letters and numbers, shown in SysWatch on your PC. It never contains 0, 1, I or O.
That address does not look right
Type it the way your PC shows it, for example 192.168.1.5. No http and no port.
That port does not look right
Use the port shown on your PC. It is 47800 unless you changed it.
That is not a SysWatch code
Scan the QR that SysWatch shows on your PC, under Pairing.
Scan the QR with your phone\'s own camera app instead, or type the code.
You can type the code instead, or allow the camera for SysWatch in Android settings.
Check the code on your PC and try again. If a new code was made there, the old one stops working.
